policy: Keep existing IDs valid while workers are active; reconcile after source review. Shared labels do not by themselves establish identical concepts.

identity_checks.reason: Oalu is described as an unrecognized outer world whose inhabitants mostly lack hive mind, explicitly distinct from Martian Mantis. Ohalum is identified with Eris and a hive-queen polity with a cooperating Mars colony. Similar names and insectoid councils do not establish one identity.
